FAQ:
What is the Alexandria Pet Center?
The Alexandria Pet Center is a specialized veterinary center that provides integrated services for pets. It is the first center specializing in surgery, accidents and fractures for pets in Alexandria, under the supervision of Dr. Mohamed Ali, consultant of general surgery, orthopedics and fractures for pets.
Who is Dr. Mohamed Ali at the Alexandria Pet Center?
Dr. Mohamed Ali is a consultant in general surgery, orthopedics and fractures for pets, specializing in treating injuries and fractures and performing various veterinary surgeries for pets.

Alexandria Pet Center, supervised by Dr. Mohamed Ali, Consultant of General Surgery, Orthopedic Surgery, and Fracture Treatment for pets, provides medical examinations, vaccinations, surgeries, X-rays, laboratory tests, grooming, boarding, and veterinary care services with advanced facilities across Alexandria.
Alexandria Pet Center is one of the leading specialized veterinary centers providing complete healthcare for pets under the supervision of Dr. Mohamed Ali, Consultant of General Surgery, Orthopedic Surgery, and Fracture Treatment for Pets.
